    // The shrunken copy of an original face: its own edges' midpoints, in order.
    AmboFaceOfFace(self: PolygonMesh3D, face: Integer): Array<VertexIndex>
        => self.FaceArity(face).MapRange(slot =>
            VertexIndex(self.CornerUndirectedEdge(self.FaceCorner(face, slot)).Value));
